about: The Workbench icons of the Toppler drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own 40x40 icon (dist/toppler40.xpm, GPL like the game). Toppler-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Toppler.info beside the drawer; toppler.info is the program's. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-toppler, COPYING.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
